primary.citation: Chen, D. (2015). Online Retail. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5BW33
primary.license: CC BY 4.0, as stated by UCI
primary.name: UCI Online Retail
primary.oracle: SQLite GROUP BY/SUM computed outside the VM
primary.privacy: projection retains row number, invoice, stock code and integer quantity only; customer identifiers, descriptions, dates and prices are dropped before use

required_additional.purpose: reach the frozen 10 GiB retained-state target under the enforced 2 GiB memory cap
required_additional.rule: freeze its identity and its own independent oracle before tuning; source-row volume must not be relabelled as database size

envelope.transport: plain HTTP on a numerical loopback address behind a trusted TLS-terminating gateway on the same node
use_cases: authenticated JSON HTTP request/response over transactional order and inventory state
operator maintenance: snapshot, key rotation, restore

invariants: every accepted write is durably published or reported failed; no acknowledged write is lost across restart
replayed or duplicate ingestion never double-applies a line item; per-SKU totals equal the independent oracle exactly
a read never returns data outside the namespace, tenant or session the request is authorized for
an authenticated snapshot never decrypts under a wrong key or store identity; an older valid snapshot is detected as replay when rollback authority is configured
monetary and temporal values are exact: no binary floating point, no silent rounding, no non-finite value crossing a boundary
a trap, cancellation or deadline never leaves a descriptor, mapping or resource reservation charged after its owning scope ends

known_gaps.gap: the shipped backend bounds one snapshot at 64 MiB and rewrites it whole; it cannot hold the frozen 10 GiB retained state
no OS isolation profile is installed by any execution path
no measurement against any frozen latency, throughput, availability or recovery target exists
native, SQLite, TLS and cryptographic internal allocations are not accounted within the resource budget
gateway and forwarded-identity boundaries are not qualified through real network paths
no independent security review has been performed

out_of_model: hostile code executing in the host process
a compromised host or root account
denial of service beyond the configured bounds
the security of the external TLS gateway itself
unsupported: multi-node clusters, horizontal replication and cross-node consensus
hostile code executing in the host process
live schema migration without operator sequencing
LSP or Guard offered as a hosted service for untrusted input

revision_reason: Initial freeze of the single-node Linux container envelope selected for issue #3.
